_note: Battle barks (src/combat/barks.gd). Keys: a character id, 'class:<class_id>', 'team:0' (crew) or 'team:1' (Doctrine). Events: battle_start, turn_start, crit, kill, ally_down, low_hp, big_hit, miss, heal, victory, buzzed, shield_down. A line is text, or {text, voice (res://… recording), chance}. A character's own lines win over its class, then its team. Lines on a character's 'barks' field (CHARACTERS tab) win over everything here.

battle_start: Okay. Plan. We have a plan. Mostly.
Everybody act like this was the idea.
crit: Called it. Didn't call it. Still counts.
low_hp: This is fine. This is a strategic bleed.
ally_down: No no no — we're not leaving anyone at this bar!
miss: The plan had that one hitting.

battle_start: I know every blind spot on this floor. Follow me.

crit: Oh no. Did I do that?
